qualifications: Single shared host, two ranks, small physical case; these local costs are not an assertion of stable total speedup or cluster scaling.
All modes use identical exact KSP relative/absolute tolerances and unchanged physical field/history gates.
Statistics include three successful timing samples; reference and warmups are excluded.
Timings marked rank0 are rank0 observations, not global maxima. fsi_action_report cell/event counters are global sums.
owned_cells and halo_cells are current partition list sizes, not cell-action event totals; preserve them per step without summing over time.
Baseline mono_mf does not request fsi_assembly_report, so its missing action report is recorded as null, not zero.
Paired ratios compare candidate and baseline from the same timing round; a ratio below1 means less measured candidate time.
